rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person who speaks well.

example.english: They are really articulate; they can explain even the most difficult ideas clearly.
example.traditional: 佢真係好識講嘢，幾難嘅道理都講得明。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sik1 gong2 je5 gei2 naan4 ge3 dou6 lei5 dou1 gong2 dak1 ming4

rows.note: Use this when the speech, explanation, or wording is clear and easy to understand.

example.english: You articulate yourself very clearly, so I understand as soon as I hear you.
example.traditional: 你講得好清楚，我一聽就明。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2 ngo5 jat1 teng1 zau6 ming4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for expressing an idea clearly or putting a thought into words.

example.english: I can't really articulate my feelings.
example.traditional: 我唔係好識表達自己嘅感受。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 sik1 biu2 daat6 zi6 gei2 ge3 gam2 sau6

rows.note: Use this when someone succeeds or fails to put a thought, reason, or feeling into words.

example.english: They finally managed to articulate why they were so angry.
example.traditional: 佢終於講出嚟點解咁嬲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 gong2 ceot1 lei4 dim2 gaai2 gam3 nau1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on making a message or explanation clear, including speaking clearly in general rather than precise enunciation.

example.english: Can you articulate that a little more clearly?
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 cing1 co2 di1

rows.note: Use this specifically for enunciating or forming speech sounds clearly.

example.english: A host needs to articulate clearly.
example.traditional: 做主持最緊要咬字清楚。
example.jyutping: zou6 zyu2 ci4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 ngaau5 zi6 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this when the effectiveness comes from presenting ideas in a clear, well-organized way.

example.english: You articulate your report in a very organized way, and it sounds convincing.
example.traditional: 你份報告講得好有條理，聽落好有說服力。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan6 bou3 gou3 gong2 dak1 hou2 jau5 tiu4 lei5 teng1 lok6 hou2 jau5 syut3 fuk6 lik6
